refs.quote: The Burning and Suppression of Solids (BASS) experiment hardware is a small flow duct that provides containment for small scale burning of solid samples within the Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG) aboard the International Space Station (ISS).
Astronaut Chris Cassidy conducted a calibration test on the morning of GMT (Greenwich Mean Time) 2013-095 in the Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG)

The Burning and Suppression of Solids (BASS) experiment hardware is a small flow duct that provides containment for small scale burning of solid samples within the Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG) aboard the International Space Station (ISS).
